messages:
alice: Heads-up: PR 4187 updated with migration guide + JS/TS SDK snippets. Vercel preview failing with 502 on `/assets/icons/*`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4187
ci-bot: CI matrix: lint ✅, build ⚠️ (asset pipeline mismatch on node 18 job). See logs: https://ci.redwood/4187/jobs/22
omar: I can take a look at the Vercel build. Quick Q: did you add any new webfont files or change mkdocs config?
rachel: I added a small icons sprite under docs/assets/icons. Local `mkdocs build` passes for me. I tested with node 20 in my container though.
alice: Thanks. We support node 18 in CI so mismatch could be the cause. I pushed a commit adding an engines section to package.json to force node 20 for local but CI still runs 18.
preview-bot: Vercel preview deployment failed: 502 Bad Gateway. Error snippet: "Failed to fetch /assets/icons/sprite.svg (upstream timeout)".
omar: Workarounds: 1) re-deploy from Vercel UI; 2) clear Vercel functions cache; 3) avoid large inline svgs for now and use external CDN for sprite.
docs-bot: Reminder: merge hours 10:00-11:00 PDT for docs-only changes to avoid cross-team release windows.
ci-bot: Suggestion: run the build in the same node version as CI locally: `docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/src -w /src node:18 bash -c "npm ci && npm run docs:build"`.
rachel: I added Docker snippet to PR description with that command. Also included `mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000` for local quick check.
alice: Two asks: (1) can someone retry the Vercel deploy? (2) let's confirm the preview artifacts serve icons. If still flaky we can temporarily point the sprite at the S3 bucket we use for assets.
omar: Redeploy started via Vercel UI. If it fails again I'll push a tiny commit to trigger deploy.
ci-bot: CI rerun (attempt 2) started. Note: asset hashing step recently flipped in the pipeline; might need to pin the `mkdocs-material` plugin version.
rachel: Good catch, I'll pin the plugin in the PR and push.
preview-bot: Redeploy succeeded: https://4187--docs.vercel.app (icons load for me).
omar: I checked the page and ran a quick smoke test on the SDK snippet. JS + curl examples both render fine.
alice: I left two non-blocking nits in the PR (wording + extra blank line). Can we squash commits before merge? We prefer one commit per docs PR.
docs-bot: Please follow squash-and-merge for docs PRs. Also add a short changelog entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md when the change affects public guidance.
ci-bot: Final CI: all green. Build artifacts size: 2.1MB (normal). Link-checker: warning on an external example.com URL (transient).
rachel: I updated the external link to use an archived link to avoid linkcheck failures. Pushed and rebased onto main.
omar: Approved. I can merge during the 10:00-11:00 PDT window.
alice: Approving as well, will merge at 10:05 PDT. Pinging @rachel when merged so she can update the release notes.
rachel: Thanks! Will post a short blurb in the docs channel about the new streaming migration guide and examples.
alice: Merged at 10:06 PDT (squash). Thanks everyone for the quick help. Closing thread.
